contracts.action: notifyOverridesChanged() moved from runSwitch's persistActive into the shared afterCommit of activeTransactionDeps
contracts.equivalent_path: WorkspaceSettings.refresh calls deps.changed (= notifyOverridesChanged) itself when the active workspace's overrides change on a read; initWorkspaceSettings wires that and setOverridesSource
contracts.before_after: switchWorkspace runs persistActive (reg.setActive, then workspaceSettings.refresh(target)), then dropPendingCaptures, then afterCommit(gate.commit(target)). So the notify now runs only after the switch is certain and after the target's overrides are cached. Before this change it ran inside persistActive, ahead of the commit. relocateActive (Change folder… on the active workspace) shares afterCommit, so it now notifies as well. There, notifyOverridesChanged recomputes, finds nothing changed and returns early, so it is harmless.
contracts.visible_effect: notifyOverridesChanged recomputes the effective settings. If they differ, it wakes the main listeners and sends settings:changed to every window, before workspaces:changed (broadcastState) and library:changed. The renderer gets the new workspace's effective snapshot as the switch commits.
contracts.failure_mode: If persistActive throws, switchWorkspace reopens the gate, aborts the windows and rethrows before afterCommit, so no settings broadcast goes out for a switch that failed. A refresh that fails or times out counts as unreadable (probe), the overrides stay inactive, and the notify then broadcasts the All-level values. That is silent, and it is the behaviour the comment at line 426 documents.
